prompts.orchard: Create a production-ready transparent sprite asset sheet for a side-view 2D pixel-art metroidvania, matching the first two regions of the supplied style reference: intricate but controlled pixel clusters, dark navy stone, muted olive foliage, warm cream sunlight, ancient fairy-tale clockwork countryside. NO scene background, NO floor slab, NO text, NO characters. Four fully isolated assets in a 2 by 2 grid with ample transparent gutters, nothing touching another asset. Top left: a mature wind-bent orchard tree, broad asymmetric olive-gold canopy, sparse small bronze bell-shaped fruits, gnarled trunk and roots spreading flat at its base; full tree silhouette, side view, canopy with air gaps. Top right: a tall narrow ancient orchard trunk with a single rightward horizontal branch near its crown, sparse leaves; a climbing reward tree structure with clear uninterrupted trunk and roots, full height visible. Bottom left: a broken grassy cliff lip/root skirt, a 3:1 horizontal strip of grass rooted into dark layered slate, dangling roots and moss; irregular bottom silhouette, zero soil background. Bottom right: small orchard boundary planting with a weathered upright fence post, leaning broken short rails, tufts of grass and 2 fallen bell-fruit; all roots on same baseline. Orthographic side view, no isometric perspective. Separate sprites, crisp transparent alpha. Objects intended to bake at about 320x320, 170x420, 320x96, 180x96 respectively at native 1 pixel per world unit. Do not include sample reference scene itself.
prompts.mill: Create a transparent modular sprite sheet of FOUR separated architectural assets for a side-scrolling 2D fine pixel-art game. Match the reference's gear-city stone, aged bronze and dark timber, but this is a quiet old rural windmill. Orthographic front/side elevation, NO perspective, NO characters, NO text, NO floor. Layout two by two with large transparent gutters. Top left: a tall structural timber bent, two vertical weathered oak posts with sturdy feet, simple cross tie beam near top and diagonal knee braces, open transparent center, bronze bolt plates, subdued moss at feet. Full extent visible; intended native size about 300x450. Top right: one tall recessed arched mill window in layered navy stone surround, pale warm cream glass, narrow mullions, attached rough timber lintel; full silhouette; intended 140x210. Bottom left: large complete vertical bronze and oak drive wheel with round hub, six timber spokes and toothed iron rim, worn and recessed-looking, separate transparent holes between spokes; intended 260x260. Bottom right: a long heavy oak corbel bracket/beam underside with three diagonal braces and metal ties, horizontal strip, open gaps, intended 320x96; no platform top, it visually supports an existing platform. Distinct detailed pixel clusters with restrained texture, desaturated shadows, luminous warm window. Crisp cutout alpha with absolutely no painted background, haze, cast shadow or ambient glow outside each silhouette. Assets isolated and never touching. Preserve coherent native pixel scale, do not copy any reference scene.
prompts.wall: A seamless tileable background wall texture for the INNER BACK WALL of an ancient rural windmill in a refined 2D pixel-art metroidvania. Orthographic flat elevation. Very dark desaturated navy slate masonry lower third softly transitioning to aged dark brown vertical wood planks in the upper two thirds; sparse thin iron fasteners. Quiet large planes, subtle uneven stone courses and timber grain, readable broad pixel clusters, low contrast, no visual noise. No gears, no windows, no pillars, no beams, no machinery, no lights, no grass, no objects. Full rectangular coverage to all edges, no vignette, no bright border, no perspective. This wall will sit well behind separately drawn structural beams and warm windows; must be subdued. 1536x1024 landscape ratio.
